---
name: Change proposal / Änderung vorschlagen
about: Agree scope before implementation / Umfang vor der Umsetzung abstimmen
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
title: "[Proposal] "
---

Opening this issue is not implementation approval. Read CONTRIBUTING.md and wait for explicit maintainer agreement for features, dependencies, schema or API changes.

### Problem and users affected / Problem und betroffene Benutzer

### Smallest useful change / Kleinste sinnvolle Änderung

### Why core instead of a plugin? / Warum Kern statt Plugin?

### Alternatives and maintenance cost / Alternativen und Wartungsaufwand

### Compatibility, security and data / Kompatibilität, Sicherheit und Daten

List any dependencies, schema/API changes, migration needs, external services or privacy implications.

### Proposed validation / Geplante Prüfung

Include PHP 8.4, real MySQL 5.7 and device/audio checks where relevant.
